sprint.name: Security Foundation & Accessibility
focus_areas: P0: Security (auth, command validation, SSRF prevention)

tasks.title: Implement JWT Authentication Middleware
tasks.description: Add JWT-based authentication to all REST API endpoints. Create login/register endpoints, token generation, and validation middleware.
acceptance_criteria: JWT token generation with configurable expiry
Token validation middleware on all protected routes
Login endpoint returns valid JWT token
Unauthorized requests return 401 with proper error message

tasks.title: WebSocket Authentication & Session Validation
tasks.description: Add authentication to WebSocket connections. Validate session IDs and implement token-based WebSocket auth.
acceptance_criteria: WebSocket connections require valid JWT token
Invalid tokens result in connection rejection
Session ID validation prevents unauthorized access

tasks.title: Command Injection Prevention
tasks.description: Implement strict command validation and sanitization in tool_manager.py and agent execution paths. Prevent shell command injection attacks.
acceptance_criteria: All shell commands use subprocess with array arguments (no shell=True)
Command allowlist validation for all tool executions
Security unit tests with injection payloads

tasks.title: SSRF Prevention in Tool Manager
tasks.description: Implement URL validation and network access controls to prevent SSRF attacks through tool execution.

tasks.title: CORS & Security Headers Hardening
tasks.description: Configure proper CORS settings and add security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
acceptance_criteria: CORS configured with explicit origin list

tasks.title: Rate Limiting Implementation
tasks.description: Add rate limiting to all API endpoints and WebSocket connections to prevent abuse.
acceptance_criteria: Rate limit bypass for admin users

tasks.title: Add ARIA Labels to Interactive Elements
tasks.description: Add proper aria-label, aria-labelledby, and aria-describedby attributes to all interactive elements.
acceptance_criteria: Axe DevTools audit passes with 0 violations

tasks.title: Touch Target Size Compliance
tasks.description: Ensure all interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 touch target requirements (minimum 44x44px).

tasks.title: Focus Management & Keyboard Navigation
tasks.description: Implement proper focus management and keyboard navigation throughout the application.
acceptance_criteria: Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements

tasks.title: Color Contrast & Visual Accessibility
tasks.description: Ensure all text and UI elements meet WCAG AA color contrast requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Color is not sole indicator of state

tasks.title: Backend Error Handler Middleware
tasks.description: Implement centralized error handling middleware with structured error responses.
acceptance_criteria: Custom exception classes for different error types
Structured JSON error responses with code, message, details
Sensitive information not leaked in production
Request ID in all error responses
Unit tests for all error scenarios

tasks.title: Frontend Error Boundaries
tasks.description: Add React Error Boundaries to catch and handle rendering errors gracefully.

tasks.title: API Error Handling in Frontend
tasks.description: Implement consistent error handling for all API calls with user-friendly messages.
acceptance_criteria: Consistent error handling in API client

tasks.title: WebSocket Error Recovery
tasks.description: Implement automatic reconnection and error recovery for WebSocket connections.
acceptance_criteria: Maximum retry limit with user notification

tasks.title: Security Test Suite
tasks.description: Create comprehensive security test suite covering auth, injection, and SSRF.

tasks.title: Accessibility Test Suite
tasks.description: Implement automated accessibility testing with axe-core and manual testing protocols.

tasks.title: Security Documentation
tasks.description: Document security architecture, authentication flows, and security best practices.

tasks.title: Accessibility Statement & Guide
tasks.description: Create accessibility statement and developer guide for maintaining accessibility.

risks.description: JWT auth implementation may require changes to existing session management
risks.mitigation: Start with backward-compatible implementation, migrate sessions gradually

risks.description: SSRF prevention may block legitimate tool usage
risks.mitigation: Create configurable allowlists per deployment environment

risks.description: Accessibility changes may affect existing UI behavior
risks.mitigation: Visual regression testing after each change
